# appdynamics_synthetic_api_jobs (Data Source)

Lists the Synthetic API Monitoring jobs configured under a Synthetic API Monitoring application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_synthetic_api_jobs" "all" {
  application_id = 10499
}

output "job_ids" {
  value = { for j in data.appdynamics_synthetic_api_jobs.all.jobs : j.id => j.description }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the appdynamics_synthetic_api_application to list jobs for.

### Read-Only

- `jobs` (Attributes List) The jobs configured for the application (id, description, user_enabled only; use the singular appdynamics_synthetic_api_job data source for full detail on one job). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `user_enabled` (Boolean)
